headline: RKEC Projects files scrutinizer report for 21st AGM
summary: RKEC Projects Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report following its 21st Annual General Meeting. The report details the voting results on resolutions presented to shareholders during the meeting. This is a routine regulatory compliance filing for the company.

headline: RKEC Projects submits annual general meeting proceedings
hook: Routine AGM proceedings filed at exchanges
summary: RKEC Projects Limited has formally submitted the proceedings of its annual general meeting to the stock exchange. The filing records routine shareholder business and annual approvals. This is a standard corporate compliance disclosure with no immediate financial impact. Indian retail shareholders can note the completion of the statutory meeting without altering investment theses.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no material impact on share price.
